4279-6112-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6112-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-1671-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-1671-2645-3430.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

435-5145-5466-8095.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

108-4013-7824.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4377-6927-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Damage Control Crew.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from exile to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2033-6965-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-6965-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-6965-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1061-7068-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Baboon Spirit.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

140-6733-7433.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

913-2440-7082-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
913-2440-7082-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

1978-4131-7170.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Living Brain.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

4446-5170-5256-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2059-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1651-2750-5640-6218.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Pheres-Band Tromper to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper, targeting Pheres-Band Tromper.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
1651-2750-5640-6218.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3464-3657-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-6479.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

1497-4289-4893-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1055-1848-6498.description:
Declare Fleet Swallower as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Consuming Aberration by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in opponents' graveyards, milling the remainder of their library.

116-719-1486-1753.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
116-719-1486-1753.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
116-719-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

331-791-3693-6093.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-3693-6093.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-2653-4826-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-2653-4826-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Archelos.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

719-1147-4050.description:
Cast Grovetender Druids by paying {2}{G}{W}.
When Grovetender Druids enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as an Ally due to Xenograft, Grovetender Druids triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {1}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

717-1742-2051.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Life from the Loam, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's third ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1037-1636-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Multani's Harmony attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1037-1636-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Multani's Harmony ability by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1636-1952.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
Another nontoken creature on the battlefield.
1636-1952.description:
Pay {1}{W} to exile the nontoken creature with a aegis counter.
Pay {2}{W} and tap Livio to return the nontoken creature to the battlefield untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1561-5165.notablePrerequisites: Target player has cards in library equal to or greater than their life total.
1561-5165.description:
With Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted on the battlefield, cast Peer into the Abyss targeting an opponent.
Peer into the Abyss would resolve (with card draw and life loss rounded up in instances of odd number of cards or life), and then the static ability on Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted dealing damage for each card drawn.
